title: FrameworkNorm
description: Framework base Archetype for Norm — the verification half of the DNA grammar. Inherits gsm/Norm through the top-level $ref and composes the catalogue-wide FrameworkAscription facet through allOf. Every non-Archetype Norm statement distributed by this repository MUST be typed by this Archetype or one of its descendants, never directly by gsm/Norm, which carries no framework membership vocabulary. Source: gsm-frameworks (framework foundation).
